thread:
Asha Patel: Quick summary from this week's onboarding tranche — compiled notes attached. Main asks: better per-route cost visibility during onboarding, clearer default policy for user data retention, and a simpler SDK snippet for Node users that avoids native build hassles. Also a couple of accounts flagged as renewal-risk if we don't unblock them this week.
Tom Nguyen: thanks Asha, can you paste the high-impact customer examples? short list helps.
Asha Patel: sure — two customers: one PLG app with heavy embeddings usage (seeing spike on per-route costs), one enterprise pilot stuck on private deploy because of KMS integration delays.
Priya Shah: for the embeddings cost spike — are they using full-context embeddings or batched incremental updates? that changes the mitigation we recommend.
Asha Patel: their engineer said full-context for search index refreshes (daily).
Evan Li: suggest short-term: recommend prefix caching + smaller batch window. longer-term: show them a cost comparison for incremental vs full rebuild. I can draft numbers.
Priya Shah: +1. also propose we add a snippet to the onboarding guide: how to enable prefix/KV caching in 3 lines.
Asha Patel: can you draft that snippet? customers reported failing native builds when installing the prebuilt wheel.
Evan Li: I'll put a minimal Node example in thread:
```js
// minimal streaming example for Node (no native deps)
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer $TOKEN`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-small', input: 'hello' })
});
const json = await res.json();
console.log(json.output);
```
Tom Nguyen: perfect. for the KMS blocker, who owns the integration playbook? @enablement-bot can you link the KMS runbook?
enablement-bot: KMS integration runbook added: https://internal/docs/kms-runbook (last updated 2025-11-02)
Priya Shah: side note on prioritization — I'd rank the items: 1) KMS integration for private deploy (renewal risk), 2) per-route cost dashboard tweak (high visibility), 3) SDK snippet + docs (low effort, high signal).
Asha Patel: agree. can product/eng commit to a short ETA for (2)? customers are asking for a per-route breakdown on the console.
Tom Nguyen: tagging product; I think a lightweight dashboard change is doable in 2 sprints if we scope to read-only per-route cost and group by model. will confirm with @Evan Li on implementation plan.
Evan Li: I'll spike it today, estimate by EOD. if we can show a mock in the next customer call that's a big win.
Priya Shah: I'll prepare an enablement email template that highlights temporary workarounds and the roadmap ETA so CS can use it in renewal conversations.
Asha Patel: thanks team — please drop any raw notes or call recordings here. I'll synthesize into a short customer-facing status update. :thumbsup:
